notes.title: State of the Game: August
notes.content: [p]Hey Club Members,[/p][p][/p][p]Another month down and more work to do![/p][p][/p][h2]What's Going On with the Game[/h2][p]It's been a busy month! Last week, we released Patch 1.3.1, which included huge optimizations, quality of life fixes, and more. [/p][p]The next update, 1.4.0, will be released today! It will include a brand NEW side story featuring two of your favorite conspiracy theorists. But that's not all! Update 1.4.0 will also include more quality-of-life fixes, a few more optimizations, and some UI updates.[/p][p]See the patch notes for details on both updates.[/p][p][/p][h2]What's Happening in the Community[/h2][p]The Discord Pixel Place event has been going on for 2 weeks now, and we've loved seeing all your art! If you haven't been participating, act fast, as there is only 10 hours left until the event is finished.[/p][p]We would also like to give a huge thank you to everyone who has joined our Discord; we just hit 200 members, as well as 7,000 unique users for the game itself! This has been an incredible experience for us, and we just can't thank you all enough. [/p][p][/p][h2]The Future[/h2][p]We have a lot planned for the future; the next Discord event is already planned, and we can't wait to hear what you think about it. Just a reminder that there won't be a side story releasing next month, but don't worry, since we're still hard at work on new content, including an October side story and the expansion content releasing December 19th![/p][p][/p][p]- Lyko Studio[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.3.1: The Optimization Update
notes.content: [p]Patch 1.3.1 is out! Here are the changes:[/p][list][*][p]Massively improved performance across the board.[/p][list][*][p]The effects of this vary based on specs and in-game location, but in general, the game should be much less resource intensive. We’ve been seeing roughly doubled frame rates on our machines.[/p][/*][*][p]For greatest effect, consider turning on the "LOD in low-density scenes" setting.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Adjusted the difficulty of Monkey Zong.[/p][list][*][p]Barrels roll slower and spawn in more predictable spots.[/p][/*][*][p]Player movement and level design have been slightly altered.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added a target frame rate setting (VSync must be off to access this!)[/p][/*][*][p]Added a setting to see your in-game FPS.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a setting to run the game in the background.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to open the map with ‘M’ during free roam.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the credits to include new team members and up-to-date expansion information.[/p][/*][*][p]Overhauled the lighting for the school hallway scene.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved environmental lighting during cloudy and stormy weather.[/p][/*][/list][p]We know a lot of these features have been highly requested, so we're looking forward to hearing your thoughts! Additionally, we will have a content update, including a new side story, in the near future.[/p][p]- Lyko Studio[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: State of the Game: July
notes.content: [p]Hey Club Members, [/p][p][/p][p]It has been a hot minute since we updated all of you on the goings-on of our game, and we are sorry about that. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]What's going on with the game [/b][/h2][p]In June, we released the 1.3.0 update with the "Amelia Directs a Movie!" side story. We hope you all enjoyed it, as we had so much fun writing it! We also fixed a few bugs and spelling mistakes in the main story. For more details, you can check out our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2953510/view/499451286721136157"]1.3.0 patch notes[/url].  [/p][p] [/p][p]There was no new update in July, but we’re still working hard on side content! We have a new side story that will be releasing in August, so we hope you look forward to it. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]HUGE NEWS [/b][/h2][p]We just did a livestream!! If you weren't able to catch it, no worries, as we uploaded the [url="https://youtu.be/QByVOrchFaQ"]VOD to YouTube[/url]! During the livestream, we announced [u]I Wanna Be A Game Dev! Expansion[/u]!! This two-week expansion will release on [b]December 19th, 2025[/b] and will wrap up the I Wanna Be A Game Dev! story. The teaser trailer is out now on our YouTube Channel, so make sure to check it out! [/p][previewyoutube="wZDmmTjtyO0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Also… we’re working on a [b][u]BRAND NEW GAME[/u][/b] that continues Neku’s journey after the expansion! We aren't going to go into detail about it yet, but please stay tuned for updates! [/p][p][/p][h2][b]What's Happening in the Community [/b][/h2][p]We just wrapped up the Porkymon Competition! A big congratulations to our Discord members @leav for winning the jury award, and to @Mitsu to winning the fan vote! Also a special shoutout to @BigCheeseMan64, as their Theodude won “Most likely to be a Team Zocket Member.” [/p][p][/p][p]We have also recently hit 5,000(!!!!) unique users on Steam. This is a huge milestone for us! We’re so grateful to all of you for your support; we definitely couldn't have gotten this far without you. [/p][p][/p][p]As a thank you for all of that, we will be doing a HUGE Discord event! We’ve created a Discord bot that lets our members play a variant of r/place, or as we are calling it, Pixel Place. Users will be able to place pixels on a canvas to create a beautiful piece of art, that might even end up in the game…? [/p][p][/p][p]We’re still figuring an exact starting date for this event, but make sure to join our Discord to find out! [/p][p]Discord Link: [url="https://discord.gg/MRwB9DFJ28"]https://discord.gg/MRwB9DFJ28[/url][/p][p][/p][h2][b]The Future [/b][/h2][p]We have a lot planned for the future, and we are super excited to bring it all to you! Thank you so much for all your love and support. [/p][p][/p][p]- Lyko Studio [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: State of the Game: May
notes.content:
Hey Club Members,

May has come and gone, and we have a lot to talk about! 

[h3]What's Happening in the Community[/h3]

First off, we wanted to thank everyone who competed in the Character Smackdown. The winning character, Amelia, will receive a dedicated side story in the next major update! If you'd like to join other community events (including an in-game scavenger hunt going on right now), be sure to join our Discord!

Also, we participated in PAX East this month, which was a blast! Thanks to everyone who came; we'll be aiming to attend more in-person events in the future.

[h3]Game Updates[/h3]

Patch 1.1.1, which included Steam achievement fixes and other improvements, was released last week. Check out the 1.1.1 Patch Notes for more details. 

Also, Update 1.2.0, which includes brand new side story content, is being released now! In this story from Yonaka's perspective, you'll join Daniel on a trip to the Rob Boss Art Museum...

[h3]The Future[/h3]

We still have a lot more in the pipeline coming your way, including future side stories, and of course, Act 2! Progress has been going smoothly, so we hope you'll look forward to what's coming.

- Lyko Studio

notes.title: State of the Game: April
notes.content:
Hello Club Members,

As April comes to a close, we wanted to update you on our progress. It's been a very busy month for us, and we have a lot to share! 

Firstly, Update 1.1.0 is finally here! Thanks to everyone for your support, even after the delays. In this update, we introduced a new side story, gave you a quick way to access character stories, improved the UI, and so much more. Check out our 1.1.0 Update post for more details.

Here’s something we’re extremely excited about: We have a booth at PAX East this year! We will be at booth 10043 on May 11th from 10am-12pm EDT. We are thrilled to have gotten a booth, and would love to meet you!

We also want to give a big thanks to our Discord community. It’s been amazing seeing such an outpouring of art and memes for the Character Smackdown! If you would like to join in on future community events, just click the Discord icon on the title screen!

Lastly, let’s talk about the future! We are planning to release more side stories in the future along with our regular updates. Act 2 is also coming along nicely; we have made substantial progress on the dialogue, art, and game mechanics. We will continue to push forward and make sure to keep you all up to date!

- Lyko Studio

notes.title: State of the Game: March
notes.content:
Hey Club Members,

The first quarter of 2025 is over! First and foremost, we wanted to thank everyone in our community, new and old, for supporting this fun little game of ours. We truly appreciate all the love and enthusiasm, and are excitedly continuing our work on Act 2!

[b]Versions 1.0.3 and 1.1.0[/b]

Version 1.1.0 will be coming out April. Originally, we hoped for March, but we delayed it to pursue some additional features; thanks so much for your patience! The update will feature a brand new side story, quick-access menus for certain game content, and improved UI.

In the meantime, we have a smaller patch, 1.0.3, coming later today! The patch will fix some points of confusion in the narrative, as well as polishing up some dialogue and improving visuals.

[b]Community Updates[/b]

March heralded our first ever Fan Art Competition! All the submissions were amazing, and we're humbled that people were inspired enough by our game to make art for it. Thanks to everyone who participated! We'll be showcasing some of the art on our socials, so keep an eye out! Plus, stay tuned for future competitions we have in store...

As of now, we're nearing 100 Steam reviews! We're super grateful for everyone who has published reviews, posted their takes on the story, and chatted in our Discord. We're always taking note of feedback and trying to integrate it into new updates.

Cheers to a new month!

- Lyko Studio

notes.title: State of the Game: February
notes.content:
Hello Club Members,

	With February over, we wanted to update you on some of our recent work. Firstly, we’re happy to announce the primary crashing issue that troubled many of you has been fixed! If you want to learn more, please check out our 1.0.2 Patch Notes. 

	Now for the fun part! We’re excited to announce Update 1.1.0, which will be released later in March. The update will include our first side story, achievements, bug fixes, and more! We’re also hard at work on some additions that will come later on, including a Linux port, controller support, improved UI, more efficient RAM usage, and more side stories for your enjoyment.

Next, we want to thank everyone who watched and enjoyed our first Club Meeting livestream! The VOD is up on our YouTube right now, for those interested in checking it out. While the stream suffered from technical issues, we are looking to improve on this in future streams.

	Lastly, we are excited to announce our acceptance into Steam’s Visual Novel Fest. So, if you enjoyed the game, please spread the word! Also, please keep the feedback coming; we want to make sure we are making our game the best it can be.

  - Lyko Studio

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 is Out!
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.2 is out! Here are the changes:
[list]
[*]Patched the primary issue causing crashes (details below).
[*]Corrupted save files are now detected in the load screen.
[*]Corrupted save files no longer prevent other save files from showing up in the load screen.
[*]Fixed a minor issue related to Emi's story event.
[/list]
After two months of investigation, we found the source of the persistent crashing many people have been reporting! There's an issue with Unity's Visual Scripting package, where data will slowly build up in the stack as you progress from node to node, without ever being freed. This meant that, especially on Windows machines with a smaller stack size, crashes could happen as often as once a week.

We implemented a system that manually frees said stack data every time a new day starts, so it's extremely unlikely enough data will build up to cause a crash. We found internally that this fixed all instances of the issue, but if you continue to experience problems, please let us know!

Thank you all so much for your patience, and apologies for those of you who were affected! This issue was just as frustrating for us as we imagine it was for you.

- Lyko Studio

notes.title: State of the Game: January
notes.content:
Hello Club Members,

    As the first month of 2025 has drawn to a close, we wanted to update all of you on what we’ve been up to. We have listened to a lot of community feedback, and we know there is a prevalent issue of random crashing while playing the game. This has been our top priority, and what we have been focusing the majority of our time on. We have found that the crash is being caused by an Access Violation, which is an issue that can have many different causes. We understand your frustration and are working diligently on fixing this issue. We also know that on occasion, people have been having issues with their save files. We are implementing a system that creates backup saves, so in the event of a corrupt autosave, you will always have an earlier autosave to go back to. 

    We are also happy to report that Act Two of the game has officially entered full production. While we do not have an exact timeline or a release date yet, we will make sure to keep you all apprised of our progress. In the meanwhile, we plan to release content updates that let you explore forgotten story lines and new perspectives. 

    We do ask for your patience as we work on this game in our free time, and want to make sure that we are delivering the best possible product to all of you. As we look to the future, we are very hopeful. When we started making this game, we never dreamed we would cross 3,000 downloads, or gain a Discord community of more than 100 people. We are very thankful for your support, kindness, and love. Thank you!

 - The Lyko Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 is out!
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.1 is out! Here are the changes:
[list]
[*] Added support for ultrawide displays.
[*] Added support for windowed mode (via a checkbox in the settings menu).
[*] Added automatic resolution changes if the current one isn’t supported by the display.
[*] Made minor audio/visual improvements in the park, town, cabin, and arcade locations.
[*] Removed a way to go out of bounds in the town location.
[*] Fixed some instances of the wrong character being displayed during a line of dialogue.
[*] Fixed a floor-clipping issue that took place after Yonaka’s story events.
[*] Fixed an issue which allowed for fast travel at certain unintended times.
[*] Fixed numerous typos during the Partner Game Jam events.
[*] Fixed some slight inaccuracies in how certain stat bars show their progress.
[/list]
We’ve also been made aware of crashing issues by some players. While we haven’t found a consistent, reliable way to replicate the crash, we have found that the game often uses more RAM than expected, which may be connected. We’re aiming to fix this in the next update, though it will take some significant code changes, so we appreciate your patience while we work hard on the issue!

Thanks for being a part of the Game Dev Club!

- Lyko Studio
